text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor login, helps confirm that users are who they claim to be. Developers must also validate all input carefully, because unsafe data can open the door to attacks. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, appear when applications trust user input without checking it. By following good security practices from the start, developers can build safer websites and protect both their users and their data.
